verses.14:17: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانࣲ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتࣲۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظࣱ‏

meaning: The root جُرْعَةٌ (jurʿah) refers to a gulp or a single swallow of liquid, like water. It's similar to a mouthful of food. The term can also describe a small sip or draught.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
